parameters.query:
SELECT 
  us.user_id,
  us.semantic_threshold,
  us.llm_threshold,
  us.digest_frequency,
  us.digest_time,
  us.timezone,
  au.email AS user_email
FROM user_settings us
JOIN auth.users au ON au.id = us.user_id
WHERE us.email_digest_enabled = true
  -- L'heure locale de l'utilisateur a atteint ou dÃ©passÃ© son heure programmÃ©e
  AND (now() AT TIME ZONE us.timezone)::time >= us.digest_time
  -- Cas daily : pas envoyÃ© depuis 20 heures
  AND (
    (us.digest_frequency = 'daily'
     AND (us.last_digest_sent_at IS NULL
          OR us.last_digest_sent_at < now() - interval '20 hours'))
    OR
    -- Cas weekly : pas envoyÃ© depuis 6 jours
    (us.digest_frequency = 'weekly'
     AND (us.last_digest_sent_at IS NULL
          OR us.last_digest_sent_at < now() - interval '6 days'))
    OR
    -- Cas manual : jamais dÃ©clenchÃ© automatiquement
    (us.digest_frequency = 'manual' AND false)
  );

SELECT name, weight
FROM user_interests
WHERE user_id = '{{ $('Loop Over Users').item.json.user_id }}'
  AND enabled = true
ORDER BY weight DESC;

INSERT INTO papers (
  user_id,
  arxiv_id,
  title,
  abstract,
  authors,
  url,
  published_at,
  semantic_score,
  llm_relevance_score,
  primary_topic,
  reason,
  summary
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.user_id }}',
  '{{ $json.arxiv_id }}',
  '{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.abstract.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  ARRAY[{{ $json.authors.map(a => `'${a.replace(/'/g, "''")}'`).join(',') }}]::text[],
  '{{ $json.url }}',
  '{{ $json.published }}'::timestamptz,
  {{ $json.semantic_score }},
  {{ $json.llm_relevance_score }},
  '{{ $json.primary_topic.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.reason.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.summary.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (user_id, arxiv_id) DO NOTHING;

UPDATE user_settings
SET last_digest_sent_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
WHERE user_id = '{{ $('Code in JavaScript2').item.json.user_id }}';
